run_launcher_main: run the launcher.py main function to package and launch CIFAR10 training jobs on Kubernetes
create_experiment: create an xmanager experiment with xm_local.create_experiment for the cifar10 training run
package_python_container: package a PythonContainer executable with xm.PythonContainer and xm_local.Kubernetes.Spec for Kubernetes execution
add_tensorboard_job: add a Tensorboard auxiliary job with tensorboard.add_tensorboard to monitor training logs on Kubernetes
add_training_jobs: add multiple xm.Job trials with different learning rate hyperparameters to the experiment
